messages:
nate: Heads up — promote for release/2.5.0 is blocked, canary e2e failing consistently on migration_v27 timeout (locks the migrations table).

nate: Failure looks like migration ran but hit a lock wait timeout during schema patch. Logs: 'ERROR: could not obtain lock on relation \"migrations\" after 120s'.

ci-bot: Canary pipeline failed: postsubmit/e2e-canary (exit 1) — see https://ci.internal/runs/98765 :x:

erin: Is this the new long-running migration Leo added in #4521?

leo: yes — added backfill + index build. Locally index build takes ~2m but on canary DB we see contention, likely due to overlapping writes from test fixtures.

sasha: Deploy-bot paused promotion due to failing canary: :warning:

deploy-bot: Promotion paused for release/2.5.0 by CI gate (canary e2e failed). I will auto-unpause when canary passes on main.

erin: Options: 1) increase migration lock timeout and re-run canary 2) make the index build concurrent (safer) and rerun 3) cut migration into smaller steps and re-run 4) revert the migration commit and keep the change window, then reintroduce later.

leo: Concurrent index is best long-term but needs code changes. Quickest is bumping lock timeout to 5m for canary runs only. We can add a migration flag to skip index in canary.

nate: If we change test DB provisioning to reduce concurrency maybe that helps too. But that touches infra templates for the canary job.

erin: We should avoid reverting in the middle of a change window unless we can't unblock within the hour. What time is the change window cutoff?

sasha: cutoff in 45m. If canary green before cutoff, proceed. If not, move to next window.

leo: I'll open a tiny patch to make the index CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY and add a feature-flag defaulting to enabled. Patch command: ```git checkout -b feat/migrate-concurrent-idx && sed -i "s/CREATE INDEX/CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY/" migrations/027_add_index.sql && git commit -am "make index build concurrent for migration_v27" && git push origin feat/migrate-concurrent-idx```

erin: If you push that, we can trigger a canary-only pipeline run that exercises migrations. CI note: run with CANARY_DB_SIZE=small to reduce runtime.

ci-bot: Manual pipeline trigger link: https://ci.internal/manual/98765?action=rerun-with-params

leo: Pushed patch, starting rerun now.

nate: Also add release notes blurb in case we end up cutting: "Temporarily held migration_v27; will be retried with concurrent index build."

erin: Good. Also add an entry to changelog and a follow-up ticket to monitor latency after concurrent index (DB-814).

ci-bot: Rerun started — waiting on migration stage.

deploy-bot: Reminder: if pipeline still failing at cutoff, deploy-bot will mark release as deferred and notify release-managers.

leo: update 1749924600: rerun hit the same lock timeout, looks like concurrent index still blocked because of test fixture writes. Trying a different approach: split index into a noop-safe partial and run a background job to backfill later. Opening PR #4580 now.

erin: If that still doesn't clear canary, we should revert migration commit and proceed with the rest of the release. We'll include rollback notes and plan to reapply migration after the release window.

nate: update 1749925200: rerun still failing, cutoff reached. We are deferring promote to next change window. deploy-bot moved release to pending and left canary deployed but not promoted.

sasha: I filed the deferment: will update the release calendar and ping stakeholders. Action items: leo -> split migration + follow-up DB ticket, erin -> prepare rollback text if we need to revert, nate -> update release notes and notify PMs.

nate: closing this thread for the window. Will reopen if anything new upstream. :calendar:
